document: ONE minimal integrated v12 successor, all nine v11 findings plus three package integration blockers; NOEXEC
author: ContinueRQLS10b
preserved_fixed_core: Mandatory owned /bin/date helper state machine, leader-reaped vs full settlement, one verified TERM and bounded exception cleanup, all-predicate timely clearance, full UID/version brackets, retained root descriptors, mixed-UID fail-closed behavior, all-post-baseline unproved ownership, every-retry resource latches and independent parent release remain. V10 weakening is not restored. Earlier sources unchanged.

findings.title: late main reap bypasses runtime; lost GO age
findings.implementation: enforce_runtime runs before and AFTER waitpid even on successful reap. Reaped status is published to self.rc before the post-wait enforcement can signal, preventing signalling a reaped/reusable PID. Any elapsed wall obligation creates DEADLINE; observation beyond wall+sample_s+0.05s additionally latches MAIN_DEADLINE_ENFORCEMENT_LATE. Late native returns in the observation exception path also enforce runtime. GO again requires spawn age <= min(60,max_wall_s/2), positive remaining runtime and fresh fit.
findings.limit: Native calls remain uninterruptible; a late return is fail-closed, not a latency guarantee.

findings.title: obsolete process census at ACK
findings.implementation: After both publications/readbacks/fsyncs and fresh accounting, ACK obtains a new complete full census. For a clean result it must be empty-owned/unproved; for an already UNSETTLED result it may retain only a subset of the originally evidenced blocker identities, never add new ones. Incomplete/new blocking coverage refuses ACK. Fresh census age is checked before and AFTER stdout completion; summary carries the actual ack_census and current owned/unproved lists. New failures/trips are compared against immutable frozen code tuples, not shared mutable receipt lists. Parent independent end-proof remains mandatory.

findings.title: actual stability age missing
findings.implementation: admission.stability_max_age_s restored with positive maximum300. authorization_io requires a canonical timezone-aware stability now_date, parsed and bound to the receipt digest. A successful actual /bin/date records a conservative pre-reading monotonic bound and whole-second epoch floor. Stability upper-age = date_floor - stability_epoch +1s resolution + monotonic elapsed from BEFORE helper reading/cleanup. Future timestamps and stale/missing observations refuse commits. Only the first clock-establishing HELPER commit may lack an actual date observation; science/GO/ACK never skip it.
findings.availability: The frozen stability window is enforced at ACK too. Long runs outliving300s may refuse ACK; no undocumented lifetime extension or clock-based scope reduction is assumed. Parent policy disposition is required if longer operation needs another reviewed freshness design.

findings.title: authorization cached before preparation I/O
findings.implementation: spawn_registered re-reads exact GO/stability bindings INSIDE the protected block after pipe/preparation I/O immediately before helper or science spawn clocks. GO and ACK also re-read bindings as the LAST preparation I/O before fresh commit clocks, then require a recent census. Immutable cached binding must equal the new actual digest/fields; revocation/replacement seen during preparation refuses commitment. No stronger filesystem atomicity than this protected final-read boundary is claimed.

findings.title: pending cancellation and expiry after ACK/GO completion
findings.implementation: completion_check executes while cancellation is still masked AFTER actual GO write/close and ACK write/flush. It checks pending signals, unhandled cancellation, fresh raw authorization expiry/fit and actual stability age. Resource census age is checked after completion as well. An irreversible printed ACK that overruns or receives pending cancel returns14 without a contradictory second stdout line; the parent's actual-exit/summary join rejects it. Delivered GO is recorded as delivered before its post-completion failure, then stopped/failed rather than concealed.

findings.title: publication crosses aggregate OUTPUT
findings.implementation: Exact once-serialized receipt+settlement buffers must satisfy preexisting charged bytes + EXACT payload <= output_trip_bytes in addition to publication cap/reservation/free/lane predicates. Failure refuses publication rather than rebuilding an unbudgeted failure record. Post-publication ACK accounting again requires aggregate charged bytes <= output_trip_bytes. Parent late-name/digest audit remains separate and indispensable.

findings.title: unproved identity/coverage history lost across retries
findings.implementation: Separate immutable-growing unproved_history retains first/last identity and monotonic observation bounds for every observed unproved uniqueid, regardless of later exit or successful retry. coverage_history retains every unresolved identity/accounting observation, independently of returned census. census_observations retains ALL helper/incomplete/complete retry resource and ownership observations with phase and helper flags for exact extrema reconstruction. History caps(8192 identities,16384 unresolved records,4096 censuses) latch and fail closed; no silent dropping. Histories are in receipt and fresh ACK evidence, retaining parent reconciliation obligations even for already-ended identities.

findings.title: staged inode identity lost before link
findings.implementation: publish returns BOTH verified digest and original created/fsynced inode identity. linked_publication carries that original identity through os.link and requires final name AND staged name both equal it with nlink2, as well as digest/readback. Launch publication uses the returned original inode directly instead of restatting a replaceable pathname. Receipt caller is updated to the same tuple API.

findings.title: overrun flag may not cross actual budget
findings.implementation: Injected delay now waits until the actual call deadline plus0.01s, records mono_injection_start/end and checks that the end strictly crossed mono_call_deadline. These fields are retained in helper reports; the new qualification checker must prove the crossing. No assumption that setting a flag alone establishes its intended cause.

package_integration_repairs.repair: observe writes its complete resource/census sample BEFORE attempting clearance, so the fast clean return cannot precede its first observation; original all-predicate clearance method remains intact.

Every census is retained in census_observations, including phase/inside-helper flags, limits-relevant values and complete/incomplete status. Package can reconstruct maxima from the exact enforced observations instead of guessing from only outer samples.
date_now refuses with REFUSED_NO_AUTHORIZATION and null when no authorization exists; it does not spawn, invent a date or append HELPER_CALL_FAILED merely to timestamp an isolated admission refusal.

verification_boundary: AST/static parsing/name/call-site checks only. No module import, test, helper, supervisor, qualification, solver or science execution. Exact new qualification package follows the frozen interface. No source acceptance or runtime authority implied.
